- I guess there's a measure to meet,
  Who cares, when destination
  Remains there, not here,
  The wear and tear of the soles of the feet?
  
  Who's frame determines and who's in tow?
  What a picture discloses
  Is a break from walls unnoticed,
  Severance in the unconditioned flow.
  
  Do I measure up to the arbiter,
  Who's measure I DO see through?
  It still matters, for to be true
  Is to land in the lap of the answerer. 
  
  The successions of choices lead
  To where, now, the voice accedes
  Bitterly to the frames enthroned.
  
  But time and will together breathe
  Through grace's bounteous seeds received,
  The Truth's one solid gait intones.
  
  The frame must be crossed over,
  Let the paint bleed from its zone,
  Mountains move for Sophia's rover,
  Beloved, implore me, "walk alone."
  
  To be straight and clear, I'm simply tired,
  Beyond accepting the commonly mired,
  The mask slipping toward the sacrificial fire,
  For I have walked long beside the pyre,
  Against the pressures of the aeon's desire,
  To bring to fruition what none yet know.
  I feel in hand exactly what retires
  Those forthright footholds dug by the dire
  Advocates of ignorance, held as live wire,
  Yet brick and bone brewing for the desperate squire,
  The one who holds the art as if it were so.
  
  What wish could I have to raise the Earth upwards from below?

- I feel less a curiosity than an oddity,
  Untold treasures in the vault but no exchange could offer me
  A way, by any rate, to pay into the culture's commodity.
  
  Though made to commune and consume the common tunes,
  Your bread and wine are no nourishment or boon
  To one who's tasted the nectars of the Moon.
  
  Though afloat and persisting I live in debt
  To ways and views I know so brittle, yet
  Overarching; marching on, how illusions beget!
  
  No matter the extrication from my own story,
  I am subsumed into fictions that live out before me,
  Unquestioned depictions making a tapestry, poorly.
  
  Do I sit and acquiesce, smile and let silence forsake it?
  Formless beloved, you've given form, such that I would make it!
  War nonetheless, though, in solitude or related.
  
  What's one to do, I ask, when a clarity arrives
  To reflect back one's own sight as a priori decried
  Before Reason's employ could honest, catch or deny?
  
  What becomes of the heart when one's foreign bride
  Is awkwardly allowed yet never truly let to arrive?
  How love carries ration wholly from its own side!
  
  How much a clarion call, to deaf ears, is but a thorn in the side.
  
  - I'm starting to notice, as I spend more time on holiday with my dad, his wife, my step siblings, one of my brothers, plus friends and partners thereof, is that I've become so used to having to shoulder being subtly denied myself, and so used to morphing and melding to the expectation of who I ought be, of being understandable, of fitting their frames of reference, that I have generated a compensatory inward complex of anger and vitriol, as well as unbridled desire, both of which seek ways to be known truly, either by breaking the other down to the rudiments of their conceits, or fantasising about bringing someone into my world. I am surrounded by people who value and, for their merits, have some modicum of success and recognition in the external worldly bounds of culturally ratified modes of achievement. I feel pressure to attain to the same standard of outward capacity. I know in truth my life has sacrificed precisely these crumbs of satisfaction for the sake of a transcendental knowledge and experience that have no traction in this economy of worths, and yet I am inwardly aware of my achievements, how high and far I have gone, how deeply my knowledge sinks - and yet, it's somehow worthless, reserved for those whose frames have been allowed to sidle over the brink. None of this is new, but it comes in a new context where my O:I work and the Antykathera Essay opportunity both present a real potential... and yet somehow no one cares to ask me in depth, no ones interest seems to genuinely extend... so often I may start to speak and then they turn the conversation back upon themselves again, or the ear of interest is only halfways bent. It's the common illness, though, the inability to value beyond what values have been received, where only a grand transvaluation could help them rise out of this edifice of deceits. I was seriously affected this morning and felt a rush of sadness, especially towards my Dad who I know, for whatever reason, simply cannot fully engage with me; though he would agree and find benefit in my wisdom when it comes to what he needs as per his wife and troubles in his newest family, he cannot accept that this may be part and parcel with the worlds I've dipped myself into, the meditative depths I've attained to, the spiritual sensibilities which are co-equal with my scholarly contentions... I feel intimidation or fear turning into reactive ridicule at a subtle level, and I feel this being a more general relation projected as safe for others in the field; but for me what does this atmosphere yield? For one, insight; now I viscerally intuit the frame of reference at play, its edges, its contradictions, whomever is in question. I also gain a bounty of affective recognition, retroactive lamentation and self-conciliatory acknowledgement, that this has always been the case, that always I have been prime, ripe for scapegoating, the obvious recipient of the unconscious ignorance and bias that these "learned and cultured" people carry, for such a one-side attitude, particularly with a liberal veneer, holds beneath it a viscous tyranny born of unconscious fear, or rather fear of the unconscious, represented in myself, as a responsibility of relation, and as such as a prerequisite of sanity and health. I am the mad one, who relates honestly to the minds limit. I am the mad one, for being dubious where trust has repeatedly been betrayed. I am the mad one, for looking beyond my own ego, and the objects of mind and physis, for a value untouched by the conditionalities and partialities of human conceit. I am the daft one, because to be here in lightness I must play the fool, because the conscious of the other has stained my speech, always already, with value less than worthy, because my truth speaks from an unconscious systematically denied, dammed or barred. I think I have also yielded a better sense of self-relation, for when I say I it's very clear that I am less the appearance, more than one to whom they appear, and yet I do not fight the feeling, the thought, the glances or the jeers; I am imperfectly positioned as the perfection, the telos, drawing near, which is to say I have enough distance to hold each moment and trust it, let it be, and let i speak what, from its ephemeral angle, is momentarily clear. My line hasn't budged and won't; I am, however, yet to stand against what I cannot stand for. Many a moment on this holiday has arisen where there were reasons to stand, and I left my voice quiet, trapped in a clenched hand. The opportunities I have now could well give this voice its wings, because mountains shall move, cultures shall dissolve, re-leaven and reprove, if but an iota of my message is to fly to another mind and reproduce. I know this as a fact, that what I have spent 12 years, essentially, staking a wager on with myself and reality is of the calibre and stature, the inherent nature, of being that which mutates consciousness beyond its decaying current stage - what for most, including I, is a most detestable cage. Coming with compassion, I can see that this situation couldn't be otherwise, and those who see even a bit beneath the guise, like my brother, can, though if not understand, know and feel the need of a world led by one's like his brother. Not to bring the personal out to the transpersonal without tact; but every angle from which I'm poked is a collective distillation into a personal kind of lack, and indeed seeing this alone puts me on the other side of the tracks. I think the affective wave has mostly parted, but we've been at a vineyard drinking wine! My dearly departed, my everyday divine. I have never lauded or sought to impose my gnosis on others, but I cannot stand with the assumption that I share the status of one who holds "doxa", I have done the work to establish the covenant with the source of intuitive conception, and am careful not to claim beyond what I have been allowed to affirm undoubtedly. Still, the divinity I know is the balm and saviour, if only the knower, religious or not, could get out the way of their mind's babbling, the egoic will's subtly split behaviours. I don't preach to anyone, I stay almost always on the others side, I listen, I help, I bring joy, and when I can I provide. Perhaps the greatest yield I feel now is the true sense that I genuinely deserve the recognition to come my way, I've spent so long letting recognition be my relation to the outside! As much as inner recognition, true sight of consciousness divine, the recession of spanda, the sojourns direct to sat-cit-ananda, the completion of the experiment testing the yogic hypothesis, the diving into and unpicking the abrahamic history and its political asides that underly the present state of divide, as much as all this has been my drive, I now feel motivation to be received, not just to receive and abide. The pressure to make concrete isn't even the issue, though I notice it is an edge, a natural pressure of manifesting creative vision and turning the risk inside-out to face the arbiter's judgement; the issue is intimate and personal, it's always "no one has known me, no one wants to, no one could, time and experience have attested". Simply the motivation peaking through now is, "fuck you, by my greatness will your ways be arrested." I speak this to all that may be concerned, no matter how much in the shit they're invested; I don't speak as Frank, here, but as the next aeon bounding up from what the culture feels as a precipice wherein all sense and safety are contested. Kali is here, Krsna too for the love, Christ and his brother, Mother beside, Father above. I have earned, by having spurned this self-sense in the path of letting-loose the limited I-noose, Nous that can make the claim to carrying these symbols as cognates of its silent truth, and indeed of letting that silence find form as real, undeniable proof; this isn't hubris, or overreach, the only question is "who could here find its use?" Which is to ask "who could recognise it?" And the fuck you is necessary as motivation, just as the water pours out waters collected and washes away the age of the fishes, so too my wish is positive-annihilative, wise moving on. I take aim at the very frame of reference that frames a separate ego as self-subsisting, self-knowing in any real sense, and self-empowering... To find the valuation and respect apt to the work that I am building to heights towering, I have to burn away a fog of a whole aeon, a whole sense and sensibility, and thus make an opening in the skies to let arise a sensitivity that could come to learn what I had to earn to carry both my site and my proclivities without falling into a wreck like so many who try to carry revelations to their nativity. I guess I'm working it out, and feeling the right way, but one thing's for certain; I can't hold my tongue beyond today. When I came into the affective rush this morning it was in the inner dawning of the recognition, now the first line of one of these poems, that I am "more oddity than curiosity", i.e people actually seem to not want to get know me, as explained above. At this time, and for about 15 minutes after, I was subtly internally a wreck, but grasped by a clear-ish image of a crescent-moon-faced being holding a baby with a sun face, and I had the clear sense they were actual both children and both the parent holding the other, a sun-moon parent-child super-positional relationship which had an overwhelming sense of light about it... worth mentioning.
